name: feature-hero
blurb: Hero section with grid of AI feature cards and staggered entrance animation.
description: A centered hero heading with animated entrance, featuring a 5-card grid below (3 cards, then 2 staggered). Diagonal striped background with radial gradient overlay.
use_when: Product homepages or feature introductions where motion and visual polish underscore key differentiators.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical flows where entrance animations could distract from content consumption.
a11y: Heading is semantic; animations use whileInView triggers. No prefers-reduced-motion guard; entrance animations always play.
